source: 2026-09-30, measured by ABSOLUTE POSITION READ (position_capture.py / the local control console do_mark), never by jog bookkeeping: a zero-offset maintenance run parks the tip at the model well top, the operator confirms it sits at the physical tube mouth, and moveRelative(distance=0) reads the absolute position without moving. Result: all four 24-tube racks (slots 3/6/7/8) are (0,0,0) - the physical tube mouth coincides with the model well top - so the older -27.4..-30 (2026-09-22) and +1.5 (2026-09-29) values were wrong accumulation, not a real displacement. OPEN ISSUE: the machine's own calibration was re-done AFTER these marks (deck matrix 2026-09-30T13:48Z, left pipette 13:50Z, right pipette 13:57Z), so every value below is of order 1 mm stale and the calibration log's own reuse precondition is not met. Re-verify, in this order, before the next real run: (1) the four racks (expect 0,0,0), (2) slot 1 - y=-5.70 mm is a large PLACEMENT offset, (3) slot 4 falcon. Slot 5 was not re-measured in this session.

machine_calibration_at_mark.note: The robot calibration that was in force when the offsets below were marked (snapshot the local control console/calib_snapshots/calib_prerecal_20260930_111800.json). These offsets are a correction to a specific machine basis: a re-calibration moves every physical position, so re-measure the offsets and update this block. runner.py compares it against the live robot before every run and warns on drift.
